title: levisticum aquilegiifolium
intro: Levisticum aquilegiifolium, commonly known as Masterwort or Wild Lovage, is a perennial plant belonging to the carrot family (Apiaceae). The health benefits of Masterwort include its potential to aid in digestion, reduce inflammation, and alleviate symptoms of colds and flu due to its antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Masterwort include its ability to act as a carminative, expectorant, and diuretic, making it useful in treating conditions such as indigestion, bronchitis, and urinary tract infections. The bioactive constituents of Masterwort include volatile oils, flavonoids, and coumarins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
